summary: Dr. PSS Kiran is the consultant radiologist for musculoskeletal imaging and image guidance at Halcyon Pain Management Centre in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. An MD Radiodiagnosis physician with additional fellowship training in pain management and musculoskeletal ultrasound, he focuses on the radiological evaluation of musculoskeletal and pain conditions — reading X-rays, MRI and ultrasound alongside the clinical picture.

paragraphs: Dr. PSS Kiran is an MD Radiodiagnosis physician with additional fellowship training in Pain Management and Musculoskeletal Ultrasound. His clinical interests include musculoskeletal imaging, musculoskeletal ultrasound and the imaging evaluation of pain-related conditions.
His role at Halcyon focuses on the radiological evaluation of musculoskeletal and pain conditions, combining clinical information with relevant imaging such as X-rays, MRI and ultrasound.

sections.h2: Why imaging matters in pain management
paragraphs: An abnormality seen on an MRI or X-ray does not always mean it is the actual source of a patient’s pain. Imaging findings need to be understood in the context of the patient’s symptoms and clinical examination.
Musculoskeletal ultrasound gives a real-time view of muscles, tendons, ligaments, joints and peripheral nerves, which helps assess many musculoskeletal conditions dynamically, as they move.

sections.h2: An integrated clinical and imaging approach
paragraphs: At Halcyon, clinical assessment and musculoskeletal imaging are brought together to help identify the likely source of pain and to assist in appropriate treatment planning.

Dr. Kiran’s background in Radiodiagnosis, together with his additional training in Pain Management and Musculoskeletal Ultrasound, allows him to provide focused musculoskeletal ultrasound evaluation, imaging correlation and radiological assistance for image-guided pain procedures in collaboration with Dr. Dasyam Pallavi. His expertise complements her interventional pain practice, so the clinical and imaging information are considered together as part of an individualised approach to each patient.

faqs.q: What does a musculoskeletal radiologist do at a pain centre?
faqs.a: At Halcyon, Dr. PSS Kiran evaluates musculoskeletal and pain conditions radiologically — combining your X-rays, MRI and ultrasound with the clinical findings — and provides image guidance and radiological assistance for image-guided pain procedures, working with Dr. Dasyam Pallavi.

faqs.q: Does something on my MRI or X-ray mean that is what is causing my pain?
faqs.a: Not always. An abnormality seen on an MRI or X-ray is not necessarily the source of the pain. Imaging findings need to be read in the context of your symptoms and the clinical examination, which is why the two are considered together at Halcyon.

It is an ultrasound scan of muscles, tendons, ligaments, joints and peripheral nerves. Because it is real-time, it can assess many musculoskeletal conditions dynamically, while the structure moves, and it is also used to guide needles during image-guided pain procedures.

faqs.q: Should I bring my previous scans?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring any recent X-ray, MRI, CT or ultrasound reports, and the images if you have them. Correlating earlier imaging with the examination and a fresh ultrasound is a central part of the assessment.
